behavior: the complete intervention_actions repository boundary moves to Operations Observability while Analytics Reporting retains use-case orchestration and presentation computation
the process-local compatibility latch begins false, returns immediately only after a successful prior ensure, and becomes true only after all three DDL statements complete

compatibility DDL remains three separate sequential nontransactional statements in the inherited order: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, conditional score_at_action/outcome column repair, then CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS
a failed DDL statement leaves the latch false so a later call retries from CREATE TABLE; concurrent first callers remain uncoalesced and can each execute the idempotent three-statement sequence
the DDL remains unqualified and the conditional column checks retain their exact information_schema table-name and column-name predicates
every public repository operation defensively ensures compatibility, while Analytics explicitly ensures before caller-owned clocks, randomness and cutoff construction
action ID generation remains ia_ plus caller Date.now plus the six-character Math.random base-36 suffix and occurs only after ensure succeeds
comment trim-or-null and score nullish-to-null normalization remain caller-owned and occur after ensure and before create
create persists the exact id, manager, closed action value, normalized comment and score; created_at remains database-clock NOW through the declared compatibility-table and Prisma database default
pending selection remains outcome IS NULL, score_at_action IS NOT NULL and created_at less-than-or-equal to the caller cutoff, with no ORDER BY
the outcome window, one caller Date.now cutoff, manager score map, missing-manager skip, threshold computation and one-by-one awaited update order remain caller-owned
outcome update remains id-only, changes only outcome, ignores affected-row count and treats a missing row as successful completion
latest-action selection retains DISTINCT ON manager_id with manager_id then created_at descending order and no deterministic tie-breaker for equal timestamps
latest rows retain raw action/outcome string compatibility; timestamp ISO conversion and outcome casting remain caller-owned

effectiveness selection retains action/outcome grouped COUNT(*)::text rows, outcome-not-null filtering and action/outcome ordering; parsing, known-outcome accumulation, labels, rates and final sorting remain caller-owned

completion-timing selection retains all outcome-not-null created_at rows in descending order; the minimum sample, seven-day inclusive recent cutoff, rounding, clamping and insufficient-data result remain caller-owned
completion-timing ensure, read and mapping failures remain caught by the existing local fallback; other repository failures remain visible to their existing caller boundary
team overview still evaluates pending outcomes before loading the latest action for each manager
the four raw read SQL strings and three compatibility DDL strings are byte-identical after relocation
no transaction, batch outcome write, retry wrapper, promise latch or rollback compensation is added
bounded_drift: typed Prisma create replaces the fixed positional INSERT, so generated SQL, returned-row behavior, Prisma error class/message and recorded query text may differ; the returned row remains ignored
typed create omits created_at and relies on the exact compatibility DDL plus declared Prisma database DEFAULT NOW(), retaining database-clock semantics for conforming or compatibility-created tables
typed updateMany replaces the fixed positional UPDATE, so generated SQL and Prisma error representation may differ while zero-row success and ignored affected count are preserved

strict versioned request parsing can reject malformed envelopes, unsupported versions, extra fields, invalid dates, invalid outcomes, invalid action values and non-finite scores earlier than the legacy raw path
owner-side camel-case row mapping and public-handler frames add negligible in-process timing and can change stack traces without changing successful values
out_of_scope: the inherited Analytics imports of Work Management internal configuration
business-policy changes to intervention actions, outcome thresholds, timing windows, labels or queue priority
schema migration design, removal of compatibility DDL or raw read modernization
raw-write-owner-overrides and frozen CRM-ARCH-003 ownership evidence regeneration
database access, scheduler execution, service or runtime activation, deployment and production mutation
